sql:
SELECT
  subq_12.home_store__region AS member__home_store__region
  , SUM(subq_6.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    member_id AS member
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_6
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    members_source_src_10000.member_id AS member
    , home_stores_source_src_10000.region AS home_store__region
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_source_src_10000
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "data"."main"."stores" home_stores_source_src_10000
  ON
    members_source_src_10000.home_store_id = home_stores_source_src_10000.store_id
) subq_12
ON
  subq_6.member = subq_12.member
GROUP BY
  subq_12.home_store__region
